description: This file defines the ISC_History module for the SmartClient framework, including version info, licensing, and the implementation of the History module with functions for managing browser history and navigation.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked on history changes.

methods.name: getCurrentHistoryId
methods.description: Returns the current history ID based on URL.

methods.name: getHistoryData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a specific history ID.

methods.name: setHistoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the current history entry.

methods.name: addHistoryEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the browser history with specified ID and data.

methods.name: historyCallback
methods.description: Invokes the registered callback when history changes.
